summary: Brenmiller Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the June 1, 2026 closing of a $1.0 million funding tranche under an existing $25 million securities purchase agreement with Alpha Capital Anstalt. The company issued 1,000 preferred shares convertible at $1.67 per share and warrants to purchase 598,802 ordinary shares at $14.56 per share. Net proceeds are for general corporate purposes and working capital. The filing is a routine disclosure of a follow-on private placement under Regulation D, not a transformative special situation. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. What to watch: ordinary course capital raising; no risk-arb angle.
